articles.summary: LuxExperience B.V. (NYSE:LUXE) (“LuxExperience”), today announced the date for the release of its first quarter of fiscal year 2027 ended September 30, 2026 financial results. First Quarter of Fiscal Year 2027 Earnings Call and Webcast LuxExperience will release first quarter of fiscal year 2027 financial results before the U.S. market open on November 17, 2026. A conference call to discuss its results will follow at 8:00am Eastern Time that same day. Event: LuxExperience First Quarter of Fiscal Year 2027 Earnings Conference Call Event Date: November 17, 2026 Event Time: 8:00am ET Webcast: Please follow the link A webcast replay will be available on LuxExperience’s investor relations website at investors.luxexperience.com . Upcoming Investor Conferences LuxExperience will participate at the following investor conferences: Jefferies Miami Consumer Conference in Miami, November 17-18, 2026 J.P. Morgan Global Luxury Brands Conference in Paris, November 18, 2026
articles.title: LuxExperience Announces First Quarter of Fiscal Year 2027 Earnings Release and Conference Call; Participating in Upcoming Investor Conferences
